<title>평면도 3D · 참고 이미지 반영</title>
<style>

.15s}.switch:after{content:"";position:absolute;top:3px;left:3px;height:12px;width:12px;border-radius:50%;background:white;box-shadow:0 1px 2px #0001;transition:transform .15s}.switch:checked{background:#6c8f59}.switch:checked:after{transform:translateX(12px)}.reference-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:6px}.reference{border:1px solid small{color:#97a28b;font-size:9px}.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#1a261fd1;z-index:20;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:25px;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}.overlay.open{display:flex}.lightbox{background:#fff;max-width:min(1120px,96vw);max-height:94dvh;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 button.active{background:#e8f0df;border-color:#afc49a}.fallback-note{display:none;position:absolute;top:84px;right:21px;color:#8e967f;font-size:10px;background:#ffffffca;padding:5px @media(max-width:1050px){.app{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 255px}.sidebar{padding:20px 15px}.revision{display:none}header{padding:0 18px}.viewbar{left:16px;top:18px}.view-sub{left:18px}.stage-footer{left:17px}.stage-footer .desktop-only{display:none}}
@media(max-width:760px){.app{height:auto;min-height:100dvh;grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:63px max(490px,70dvh) auto}header{grid-column:1;padding:0 13px;gap:9px}.headline h1{font-size:14px}.headline p{font-size:9px}.brandmark{width:30px;height:30px}.header-actions{gap:5px}.header-actions .button{font-size:10px;padding:8px}.header-actions .button svg{display:none}.sidebar{border-left:0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);padding:22px}.side-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:22px}.areas{margin-bottom:19px}.roomlist{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.room-item{font-size:11px}.sidebar .reference-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);max-width:410px}.settings{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px 24px}.selection{margin-bottom:20px}.stage-footer{bottom:16px;font-size:9px}.zoom-controls{bottom:16px;right:14px}.segmented button{padding:8px 10px}.view-sub{top:77px}.viewbar{gap:5px}.overlay{padding:10px}.lightbox-head{padding:10px 12px}.download-list{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.assumption{max-width:530px}.reference span{font-size:9px}}
